title: Verify View action loads checklist step successfully with valid parameters
description: Ensures the View action returns the checklist step view when provided with valid work request ID, step number, and workflow model.
preconditions: Work request exists with checklist step

manual_steps.action: Navigate to a work request checklist step view with valid ID and step number
manual_steps.expected_result: Checklist step view loads successfully showing questions and controls

manual_steps.action: Verify the checklist questions are displayed correctly
manual_steps.expected_result: All checklist questions appear with proper formatting and input controls

manual_steps.action: Check that action buttons are visible based on permissions
manual_steps.expected_result: Save, Complete Step, and Add New Question links appear if user has edit permissions

review_note: Button labels and UI element selectors need verification from actual UI

title: Verify Save action returns QuestionsSuccess true for valid question responses
description: Tests the critical Save endpoint to ensure it returns QuestionsSuccess: true in response body when all questions are saved successfully. This tests against the known silent failure pattern.
preconditions: Work request exists at checklist step

manual_steps.action: Navigate to checklist step form and fill in all required question fields
manual_steps.expected_result: All question fields accept input and display properly

manual_steps.action: Click the Save button to submit the checklist questions
manual_steps.notes: Critical: Must check response body, not just HTTP status

manual_steps.action: Verify response body contains QuestionsSuccess: true
manual_steps.expected_result: Response JSON contains 'QuestionsSuccess': true and no error messages
manual_steps.notes: This is the key test - endpoint always returns 200 but may have QuestionsSuccess: false

title: Verify permission denied when user lacks checklist view access
description: Ensures the View action returns permission denied partial view when user lacks CanViewItems permission.
preconditions: User does NOT have checklist view permissions
Work request exists with checklist step

manual_steps.action: Navigate to checklist step view URL with restricted user account
Verify no checklist data or controls are visible
manual_steps.expected_result: No sensitive checklist information is displayed to unauthorized user

review_note: Need to confirm exact permission denied message text and UI elements

title: Verify SaveNewQuestion returns success for valid new question data
description: Tests the SaveNewQuestion endpoint to ensure it successfully creates a new question and returns the proper JSON response with the created question details.
preconditions: User has permission to add new questions
Work request exists at editable checklist step

manual_steps.action: Open the Add New Question dialog from checklist step
manual_steps.expected_result: Add New Question form appears with question text field and assignee dropdown

manual_steps.action: Fill in question text and select an assignee, then click Save
Verify response contains success flag and new question details
manual_steps.expected_result: JSON response has success: true and question object with ID and display properties
manual_steps.notes: Response should include addedQuestion with DisplayIdSafe and DisplayId

test_data.questionText: What is the status of safety equipment?

review_note: UI element names for new question form need verification. Response structure assumed from code patterns.

title: Verify Save action handles auto-completion when shouldAutoComplete is true
description: Tests the Save endpoint logic that automatically completes a checklist step when auto-completion is configured, ensuring both question saving and step completion succeed.
preconditions: Work request has auto-complete configuration enabled
Checklist step is ready for completion

manual_steps.action: Navigate to checklist step with auto-complete enabled and fill all questions
manual_steps.expected_result: All questions are filled and ready for saving

manual_steps.action: Click Save button (not explicitly requesting completion)
manual_steps.expected_result: Questions are saved and step is automatically completed

manual_steps.action: Verify response shows both QuestionsSuccess and CompletedSuccess as true
manual_steps.expected_result: Response JSON contains QuestionsSuccess: true and CompletedSuccess: true
manual_steps.notes: Both operations should succeed for proper auto-completion
